title: Plans the LLM registers
summary: jobs~plan(name)~step(name)~does(target, method, args)~passIf(kind, value). Check kinds: exitIs N (exitIs 0 on a non-program action means it completed), fileExists, fileAbsent, outputHas, outputLacks (these read the text of any result). onFail stop|continue (continue runs on, the plan still ends FAILED). timeout(s). jobs~submit(plan) is protected and starts the plan on its own thread. Each step action runs through a secured routine as llm. Plan states REGISTERED RUNNING PASSED FAILED DIED; settled means state final, owner told, inbox posted. notify fail|always. amend(newName), insertStep(at, name), removeStep(at), stepNamed(name), stepAt(at).
authority: built and tested (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: The LLM registers a multi-step plan object; each step carries its checks and pass/fail criteria (Tom Dyer, 2026-11-24)
The plan runs without the LLM watching it
Plan and watch loops run unguarded so the console can read them
